description.en: Makes your Twitch channel easier to showcase: header button, live status, latest clips and, once your channel is connected, your followers and paying subscribers. Also measures your lives (average and peak viewers, hours streamed and watched, followers per game) and the views of your videos.
description.fr: Facilite la mise en avant de votre chaîne Twitch : bouton, statut en direct, derniers clips et, une fois votre chaîne connectée, vos followers et abonnés payants. Mesure aussi vos directs (audience moyenne et pic, heures de live et regardées, followers par jeu) et les vues de vos vidéos.

label.en: Talk to Twitch (your Twitch application and connected accounts)
label.fr: Parler à Twitch (votre application Twitch et les comptes connectés)
État de la chaîne Twitch (en direct ou non)

label.en: Your Twitch schedule (the appointments published on your channel), for the modules that announce events
label.fr: Votre planning Twitch (les rendez-vous publiés sur votre chaîne), pour les modules qui annoncent des événements

label.en: Twitch followers, paying subscribers and 30-day live figures
label.fr: Followers, abonnés payants et chiffres de vos directs (30 jours) Twitch

help.en: For example mychannel. Shared with the other Twitch modules: type it only here.
help.fr: Par exemple machaine. Partagée avec les autres modules Twitch : à saisir ici seulement.

help.en: Counts your followers and paying subscribers for the site's statistics, and measures your lives: viewers, hours streamed, followers per game, views of your videos. Measured by your site every 2 minutes while you are live, from the day this is switched on: Twitch gives no history. Twitch must authorize the follower count: once this is on and saved, a “Connect my Twitch channel” button appears in the “My channel” tab.
help.fr: Compte vos followers et vos abonnés payants pour les statistiques du site, et mesure vos directs : audience, heures de live, followers par jeu, vues de vos vidéos. Mesuré par votre site toutes les 2 minutes quand vous êtes en direct, à partir du jour où ceci est activé : Twitch ne fournit pas l'historique. Twitch doit autoriser le comptage des followers : une fois ceci activé et enregistré, le bouton « Connecter ma chaîne Twitch » apparaît dans l'onglet « Ma chaîne ».

help.en: Only for Twitch affiliates and partners. Ticking it changes what Twitch is asked to authorize: reconnect your channel afterwards.
help.fr: Réservé aux chaînes du programme Affilié ou Partenaire de Twitch. Cocher cette case change ce que Twitch doit autoriser : reconnectez votre chaîne ensuite.

label.en: How often to measure during a live
label.fr: Fréquence de mesure pendant un direct

help.fr: Toutes les 2 minutes convient très bien : le site interroge Twitch à peine plus d'une fois par mesure, très loin de sa limite. Hors direct, il vérifie seulement toutes les 4 minutes.
help.en: Every 2 minutes is just fine: the site asks Twitch about once per measurement, far below its limit. Outside a live, it only checks every 4 minutes.

label.en: How long to keep the detailed measurements

help.en: The detail (one line per measurement) takes room, so it is erased after this. The summary of each live is kept much longer.
help.fr: Le détail (une ligne par mesure) prend de la place : il est effacé au-delà. Le résumé de chaque direct est gardé bien plus longtemps.

label.en: How long to keep the summary of each live
label.fr: Garder le résumé de chaque direct

help.en: A summary weighs about 2 KB: 5 years of daily lives fit in a few MB.
help.fr: Un résumé pèse environ 2 Ko : 5 ans de directs quotidiens tiennent dans quelques Mo.

mcp.name: twitch_streams
mcp.description: Lives of this Twitch channel measured by the site itself (Twitch gives no history: measures start the day tracking was switched on). One entry per live, most recent first: start, end, duration in minutes, peak viewers, average viewers (weighted by time), viewerHours (hours watched by the audience), followers gained during the live (null if the channel is not connected), games played with the same figures per game, and 'approximate' when a measurement gap or a restart of the site makes the figures less precise. Use it for 'how did my last streams go?'. An empty answer says since when the site measures.

since.description: Alternative to days: only lives started after this ISO date.

mcp.name: twitch_games
mcp.description: Games ranked by what they bring on this Twitch channel, over a period: number of lives, hours live, average and peak viewers, viewerHours, followers gained and followers gained per live hour. Sorted by followers per hour by default. Use it for 'which game makes me gain the most followers?'. followersPerHour needs the channel to be connected and at least 1 hour of live time on the game. Measures exist only since tracking was switched on.

since.description: Alternative to days: only lives started after this ISO date.

mcp.name: twitch_videos
mcp.description: Videos of this Twitch channel with their view counts: replays (archive), highlights, uploads, or clips (type 'clip'; 'all' means the three kinds of videos, not clips). Title, date, duration in minutes, views, url. Sorted by views by default; 300 videos and 100 clips at most; refreshed every 30 minutes (viewsAsOf says when). Use it for 'which of my videos are the most viewed?'.

days.description: Only videos published in the last days (default: all).

since.description: Alternative to days: only after this ISO date.
